subject: Mobile Development
title: Local Databases on Phones
description: A fast breakdown of Local Databases on Phones for builders.

hook.text: Your contacts, messages, and app data are stored in databases right on your phone.

buildup.text: SQLite is the most-used database engine in the world. It runs on every smartphone.

discovery.text: It's a single file with no server needed. Apps read and write directly to it.

twist.text: There are more SQLite instances running than all other database engines combined.

climax.text: SQLite is the silent workhorse that stores data on billions of devices.

punchline.text: The world's most popular database fits in one file.

quiz.question: What makes SQLite unique among databases?
options: It runs without a server as a single file
